opening.argument: The video directs viewers toward BitConnect lending through a referral link promising daily profit. Its description advertises a “Daily profit percentage” and links to BitConnect, while the displayed platform says users can invest BitConnect Coin in a lending platform, receive daily profit based on the investment option, and recover capital when the term ends. It further requires prospective investors to buy BitConnect Coin before entering the lending program. The page’s credited-interest table and the spoken references to an invest option and lending programs reinforce that this is a promotional path into an investment pool, tying money flow to unusually easy daily returns and capital-back claims rather than reporting, criticism, or testing.
